يتراقى (form VI)
# يَتَرَاقَى (yatarāqā) /ja.ta.raː.qaː/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative/subjunctive of تَرَاقَى (tarāqā)
# يُتَرَاقَى (yutarāqā) /ju.ta.raː.qaː/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative/subjunctive of تَرَاقَى (tarāqā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
